<!-- Thank you for sharing a pack! One pull request = one pack (or one update to a pack). -->

## The pack

- **Name:**
- **What it is for** (one sentence):
- [ ] New pack
- [ ] Update to an existing pack (I raised `version`)

## Before you send it

- [ ] The file is `packs/<id>.json`, and `<id>` is the pack's `id` (lower-case words joined by hyphens)
- [ ] It was exported from OpenTick (Settings → Sections & packs → Export), or follows [PACKS.md](https://github.com/JebbyCodes/OpenTick/blob/main/docs/PACKS.md)
- [ ] It has an author, a description, a version like `1.0.0`, a licence from the list in CONTRIBUTING.md, and a few `tags`
- [ ] It contains **no personal data** (names, emails, phone numbers, addresses) and nothing I do not have the right to share
- [ ] I have only changed files inside `packs/`

The automatic checks will comment here with your pack's **code** (what people type into OpenTick) and how it affects OpenTick's speed.
If a check fails, the comment says what to change: push the fix to this branch and the checks run again.
